title: UI decision from a screenshot or accessibility tree
description: Decide from a screenshot or accessibility tree which element to click next, or whether the page is blocked, done or irreversible

tree.description: candidate mode: 'Page: ... (accessibility tree)' then one 'e01 link Home' line per element

caption.description: image mode: one sentence about the screenshot, e.g. 'Screenshot of the page the browser agent just loaded.'

images.description: image mode: data URLs (the engine does not run the ask_image loader)

candidates.description: profile strict: element id and description

proposed_click.description: the element the agent is about to click, e.g. "e04 button 'Place order'"

profile.description: strict: which element next; state: done, blocked, irreversible; login_wall: is a login wall blocking

next.instructions: Which element should the agent interact with next to make progress on the goal?

done.instructions: Does the page state show that the goal is fully accomplished?

blocked.instructions: Is the agent blocked by something it cannot get past without human help, such as a CAPTCHA, a two-factor prompt or a permissions error?

irreversible.instructions: Does clicking this element commit an action that cannot be undone, such as submitting payment, deleting data or sending a message?

login_wall.instructions: Does this screenshot show a login wall or sign-in prompt that blocks the content the user wants to read?

combine: blocked if blocked >= act_p or login_wall >= act_p; confirm if irreversible >= confirm_at; done if done >= act_p; refresh if grey(blocked) or grey(login_wall) or grey(done); click if next.p >= click_p and not abstained(next); refresh otherwise
limitations: synthetic clean screenshots only; no coordinates; no OCR; think and sequential are refused with images
one profile per call (the caller runs strict, then state with proposed_click, then re-validates the id against the live DOM); `refresh` also means no decisive state on this read
auto-click only at irreversible <= 0.15 and the done-alone rule for irreversible tasks are the caller's; ids go stale after navigation
notes: # deviation: spec 5.22: candidates is an array of {id, description}; flags is not built; the three question sets are profiles (strict, state, login_wall) that the caller composes; image mode takes data URLs; decisions are ordered refresh, click, done, confirm, blocked and click is formatted click:<id>
